description: The M4 Competition is a track weapon disguised as a grand tourer. Its twin-turbo inline-6 produces a staggering 503 hp, delivered through an 8-speed M Steptronic transmission with Drivelogic.
The pinnacle of BMW M performance. Powered by a 4.4-liter M TwinPower Turbo V8 engine with 625 hp, sending power through an intelligent M xDrive all-wheel-drive system.
Executive luxury meets motorsport engineering. The M5 Competition blends everyday four-door usability with blistering twin-turbo V8 power and dynamic chassis control.
The most powerful all-electric BMW sedan ever created. Dual high-performance eDrive motors deliver instantaneous 748 lb-ft torque with an ultra-luxurious rear Theater Screen lounge.
The most potent BMW M car in history. A plug-in hybrid powertrain combining an M TwinPower Turbo V8 with an electric motor for an astounding 738 horsepower.
The ultimate expression of Italian performance. A naturally aspirated V12 engine delivers an unforgettable high-revving symphony with unparalleled aerodynamics.
